error[ZBX-E0557]: the export directory exists and is not empty
  cause  '/out' is not empty, and an export never writes into what is there
  fix    name a directory that does not exist, or an empty one
  more   zbx explain E0557 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0557.html
